ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels, with white pixels predominantly located on the lateral distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones located on the far left and far right outer margins of the fluke lobes. Central region is a solid low-intensity black mass with high-frequency white mottling and flecks scattered throughout the inner lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Symmetrical V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115 degrees and a shallow bounding-box penetration depth relative to total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge characterized by irregular peaks and valleys with a pixel-amplitude variation of approximately 5 to 20 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a parabolic curve from the median notch toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and elliptical high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-15 pixels in diameter) localized on the central and right lobes, consistent with localized surface scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) ranging from 1 to 3 pixels in width, oriented primarily in vertical and diagonal directions across the dark central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily scarred ventral surface featuring multiple sets of parallel rake marks and numerous circular focal scars across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast white banding on the leading edge of the lateral tips.
